reason: Client-side only change to Monaco editor initialization timing (handles cases where DOMContentLoaded already fired, e.g. dynamically loaded flows/bags), with duplicated helper logic across views but no server-side or API impact, so worst case is editor widgets failing to initialize in edge cases rather than breaking core functionality.
